text: Bankruptcy judges and the parties to a bankruptcy case may be unable to adequately evaluate Form PF data pertaining to a creditor, which limits the usefulness of that data in bankruptcy.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2348463

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy

abstract: Bankruptcy judges and/or the respective parties in a bankruptcy case may be unable to adequately evaluate Form PF data pertaining to a creditor in a bankruptcy case.
